taxonomy.subtopic: Eccentric remodeling and sarcomeres added in series

entries.learning_objective: Relate systolic failure in dilated cardiomyopathy to sarcomeres added in series, myocyte elongation, chamber dilation, and eccentric remodeling.

taxonomy.subtopic: Pseudopalisading necrosis, hypoxia, and VEGF-driven microvascular proliferation

entries.learning_objective: Connect glioblastoma pseudopalisading necrosis to hypoxia-induced HIF-1α stabilization, VEGF secretion, and microvascular proliferation.

taxonomy.subtopic: Arachnoid cap-cell origin, whorls, and psammoma bodies

entries.learning_objective: Identify a dural-based whorled tumor with psammoma bodies as a meningioma derived from arachnoid cap cells.

taxonomy.subtopic: Multifocal strictures and concentric periductal fibrosis

entries.learning_objective: Recognize primary sclerosing cholangitis by ulcerative colitis, cholestasis, beaded ducts, and concentric periductal fibrosis.

taxonomy.subtopic: Antimitochondrial immunity to pyruvate dehydrogenase complex E2

entries.learning_objective: Link the cholestatic phenotype of primary biliary cholangitis to antimitochondrial antibodies against pyruvate dehydrogenase complex E2.

taxonomy.subtopic: Activated stellate cells and desmoplastic stroma

entries.learning_objective: Explain the dense desmoplastic stroma of pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma through activation of pancreatic stellate cells and cancer-associated fibroblasts.

taxonomy.subtopic: Gsα ADP-ribosylation, cAMP, and CFTR-mediated chloride secretion

entries.learning_objective: Trace cholera toxin from persistent Gs activation to increased cAMP, CFTR-mediated chloride secretion, and massive noninflammatory watery diarrhea.

taxonomy.subtopic: ADP-ribosylation of diphthamide on eukaryotic elongation factor 2

entries.learning_objective: Identify diphtheria toxin as an NAD-dependent ADP-ribosyltransferase that inactivates eEF-2 and stops protein synthesis.

taxonomy.subtopic: Synaptobrevin cleavage and loss of inhibitory neurotransmitter release

entries.learning_objective: Differentiate tetanus from other neuromuscular disorders by linking synaptobrevin cleavage in inhibitory interneurons to loss of GABA/glycine release and spastic paralysis.

taxonomy.subtopic: SNARE proteolysis and failure of presynaptic acetylcholine release

entries.learning_objective: Explain botulism as peripheral cholinergic paralysis caused by toxin-mediated SNARE cleavage and failure of acetylcholine vesicle fusion.

taxonomy.subtopic: WASp-Arp2/3 actin remodeling at hematopoietic immune synapses

entries.learning_objective: Connect eczema, recurrent infection, and small-platelet thrombocytopenia to defective WASp-dependent actin remodeling in hematopoietic cells.

taxonomy.subtopic: Presynaptic P/Q-type calcium-channel autoimmunity and facilitation

entries.learning_objective: Recognize Lambert-Eaton syndrome as presynaptic P/Q-type calcium-channel autoimmunity causing reduced acetylcholine release and exercise-related facilitation.

taxonomy.subtopic: IGF-1 elevation and failure of growth-hormone suppression after oral glucose

entries.learning_objective: Use elevated IGF-1 and failure of oral-glucose-mediated GH suppression to confirm autonomous growth-hormone secretion in acromegaly.

taxonomy.subtopic: Ectopic endometrial glands and stroma with cyclic hemorrhage

entries.learning_objective: Diagnose endometriosis by ectopic endometrial glands and stroma with cyclic hemorrhage, fibrosis, and hemosiderin-laden macrophages.

taxonomy.subtopic: ENaC-mediated lithium entry and aquaporin-2 downregulation

entries.learning_objective: Explain lithium-induced nephrogenic diabetes insipidus through ENaC entry into principal cells, aquaporin-2 downregulation, and the targeted benefit of amiloride.

taxonomy.subtopic: Sodium-potassium ATPase inhibition and extracellular potassium shift

entries.learning_objective: Connect severe digoxin toxicity to sodium-potassium ATPase inhibition, hyperkalemia, intracellular calcium loading, and arrhythmogenesis.

taxonomy.subtopic: Seminiferous tubular hyalinization and hypergonadotropic hypogonadism

entries.learning_objective: Relate the Klinefelter phenotype and hypergonadotropic hypogonadism to seminiferous tubular hyalinization, germ-cell loss, and Leydig-cell dysfunction.

taxonomy.subtopic: Meiotic segregation in a balanced rob(14;21) carrier

entries.learning_objective: Apply meiotic segregation of a balanced rob(14;21) carrier to identify the gamete that produces three copies of chromosome 21q.

taxonomy.subtopic: Osteoblastic skeletal metastases and elevated alkaline phosphatase

entries.learning_objective: Recognize prostate-cancer skeletal metastases as osteoblastic-predominant lesions produced by tumor-stimulated new bone formation.

taxonomy.subtopic: Rapid protein C depletion and transient microvascular thrombosis

entries.learning_objective: Explain early warfarin skin necrosis through rapid depletion of protein C, transient hypercoagulability, and dermal microvascular thrombosis.
